verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Fivetran's connectors do incremental syncs and capture deletes (docs-13, docs-51, docs-35 sync modes) without requiring custom pipelines, which aligns with the general CDC value proposition, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents binlog/WAL-based log capture mechanics for database sources. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of log-based CDC (binlog/WAL) mechanism for specific databases (MySQL/Postgres/SQL Server), evidence on reduced source load/impact, and independent verification of CDC accuracy.
